_doc: ADR 0216 (owner D65 p.7-8). Per-region lighting data read by the Unity world import (WorldSceneBuilder -> EnvironmentLighting). A region not listed keeps the global behaviour (tile C, Dojlidy: unchanged). Later profiles override earlier ones field by field. All values WORKING_VALUE unless stated.

profiles._doc: Summer as the default season of the DK65 corridor and Knyszyn (D65 p.7: dusk ~21:00, sun azimuth ~300 deg). LP_Dusk keeps its sun (-6 deg, azimuth 300 deg); the clock hour that drives lit office windows becomes 21:00 instead of the November 16:10 of ADR 0199. Astronomy (artifacts/summer-led-0216/sun_summer.json): -6 deg on 31 July = 21:07 CEST at azimuth 311 deg; -6 deg at azimuth 300 deg = mid August 20:34.

White LED street lighting (D65 p.8). Nominal CCT 4000 K: ZDM Bialystok tenders 2023-2024 (research/night-lamps-s21 section 4, SOURCED for Bialystok; Knyszyn UNVERIFIED - owner declaration). ledColour is the display colour under the game's fixed daylight white balance, WORKING_VALUE chosen on the dusk control cameras so the lens and pool read white (the global default 1/0.93/0.82 reads warm against the twilight sky); it is not a colorimetric 4000 K (that would be 1/0.68/0.36 against D65).
